title: Identity-Aware BiLSTM Toxicity Ensemble
summary: The solution tokenizes lowercased comments with a regex, builds a fit-split frequency vocabulary, maps unknown tokens to a dedicated ID, truncates comments to 220 tokens, and caches train/validation encodings. A two-layer bidirectional LSTM consumes learned 300-dimensional word embeddings with channel-wise embedding dropout. Masked temporal max and mean pooling are concatenated, passed through two residual ReLU linear layers, and produce toxicity plus identity-label logits. Training uses mixed-precision Adam with epoch-wise learning-rate decay and gradient clipping. The main binary cross-entropy uses fractional toxicity targets and normalized weights that emphasize identity-containing rows, background-positive rows, and subgroup-negative rows; identity BCE is an auxiliary masked loss. A head-only stage freezes the encoder and adds a logistic pairwise ranking loss over overall, subgroup, background-positive/subgroup-negative, and subgroup-positive/background-negative pools, smooth-max aggregated across identities. Two seeded models are trained, and their sigmoid toxicity validation predictions are averaged.
